videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Secrets are being kept at the Palm Woods. Kendall and Camille are spending a lot of time together making Logan suspicious. James reveals he never told Carlos that Heather Fox, Carlos' camp crush, liked him.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The boys have the fight of all fights and decide to move out. James ends up squatting in a cool retiree’s apartment, Logan moves into a place right by the water, Carlos builds a cardboard house, and Kendall must fix things.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Big Time Rush has just dropped their second album and the guys get interviewed on an entertainment tonight-type program where they answer revealing questions about their life inside and outside of Big Time Rush.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: It's BTR's final stop on their world tour and we go behind the scenes and see all the craziness that happens backstage. Mixing in real concert footage, we see the guys prepare for the show and deal with backstage drama.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The boys return from their world tour and are now famous at the Palm Woods, but they just want to get settled and focus on girls. Griffin tries to bribe Carlos to pick his favorite song for the boys’ upcoming radio interview.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: BTR is too famous to be living at the Palm Woods, so Gustavo moves them to Bel Air. However the rules that come with upscale living don’t agree with the guys and they plot their grand escape back to the Palm Woods.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Its date night at the Palm Woods. James helps Carlos on his date with one of the Jennifers, Kendall joins Lucy’s dinner with her parents, and Logan takes a blind date out so he can spy on Camille's date with Jett.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Griffin is pitching a line of BTR merchandise to the CEO of Selmart, but the boys hate the products. Taking matters into their own hands the guys crash the meeting and accidently get their music banned from Selmart stores.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Kendall and Lucy are about to have their first kiss when her good looking ex-boyfriend Beau shows up to win her back. Griffin recruits Logan and Carlos to help him prepare for corporate espionage.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Kendall is ready to ask out Lucy, but Jo unexpectedly shows up and Kendall has to decide which girl is the one for him. Meanwhile Carlos and James’ friendship is put to the test.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Kendall and Logan must take care of Rocque Records' newest artist – an out-of-it rock legend until his induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame that night. James and Carlos are stuck babysitting Katie.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The guys want to go camping, but Gustavo nixes the idea because it’s dangerous. Instead they use their connections to camp on a sound stage, but things go awry as the guys try to show off their roughing it skills.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Kendall and Logan volunteer at a dog shelter and end up adopting 12 dogs, but a sneaky heath inspector is on to them. Carlos and Jennifer’s puppy love is sickening and it’s up to James and the other Jennifers to rescue them.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Kendall buys Jo a gold necklace to show that he’s committed, but Camille thinks Logan bought it for her. Gustavo hangs BTR’s new gold record and Carlos and James wonder what would happen if they played it.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The guys accidentally destroy the tape of the new Big Time Rush episode they were supposed to give the network. Needing a replacement episode the guys decide to make a blooper show which Stephen Glickman and Ciara Bravo host.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Big Time Invasion: BTR has to stop the invasion of the British boy band! Concerned that Gustavo is spread too thin, the boys try to hire a top music manager. Unable to agree, the four split and a rift quickly escalates within the band.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Lucy releases her revenge album about Kendall and it becomes a huge hit! James, desperate for attention, creates a rumor that he and Cher Lloyd are recording a duet, and Carlos gets bad press after he appears to hit an old lady.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The guys are caught in a web of lies. Kendall has to keep Jo from discovering Lucy has returned to the Palm Woods. Logan’s fib about being sick turns into a medical emergency and Carlos and James claim Rocque Records was robbed.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Big Time Bonus: Gustavo gives the guys a bonus for their hard work, but they quickly begin to make bad decisions with their money.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: BTR is making a cameo on a popular kid’s TV show, but Carlos’ pursuit of the show’s teen star puts him and Kendall in the crosshairs of her evil stage mother. Logan & James battle Yo Gabba Gabba over their amazing snack table.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: It’s time again for the prank war at the Palm Woods, and this time it's kids versus adults as they battle for the honor of winning Lord Prankington’s Cup.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: James continues his pursuit of Lucy and buys a motorcycle in order to impress her, but he doesn’t know how to drive it. Kendall teaches Jo how to drive stick-shift, and Carlos & Logan can’t relinquish a childhood treasure.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Logan brings Carlos along to the MCAT test as his good luck charm, but when Carlos somehow gets a higher score, Logan questions his plans to become a doctor.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The guys are pitched a kids cartoon show but instead do a video game to expand their brand. A mix-up while wearing motion capture suits puts them at the center of an extraterrestrial news story.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: After being told that boy bands always split up after the third album, the guys compete to find solo “breakout” gigs before being left behind.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: BTR is on tour with Victoria Justice and we go inside the guys’ bus to see the craziness that happens on board. When the guys get stuck in traffic, it is up to Victoria to keep the concert audience entertained until they arrive.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Big Time Dreams Pt. 1: It’s the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR is nominated and booked to close the show! However, their night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: It’s the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR is nominated and booked to close the show! However, their night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Kendall, James, Logan and Carlos are hockey playing best friends from Minnesota, whose lives are turned upside down after mega-record producer discovers them and moves them to Los Angeles to make them into the next big boy band.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: Kendall, Carlos, James, and Logan are required to attend four hours at school. However, instead of going to school at the Palmwoods Hotel, which they all have their own fantasies about, Gustavo insists that they attend school at his recording studio.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The four 'hockey heads' need some home improvement for their new apartment, despite the objections of Reginald Bitters, the Palm Woods manager.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The guys get a dose of reality when Gustavo tells them they have to go to school while they live in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The record company CEO thinks adding a fifth band member will broaden Big Time Rush’s appeal and sticks the guys with a self-proclaimed 'bad boy', who tries to inject dissension and tension within the group.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The guys all chase the same girl, causing problems in the band for the first time.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: When Gustavo has to go away on business, he lets the guys house-sit his mansion. While the boys do their best to keep the house in pristine condition, they inevitably destroy everything inside that Gustavo values.

videos.title: Big Time Rush
videos.overview: The pressure is on as the guys prepare for their first band photo, which could land them into all the teen magazines.
